decisions.H: Per-key owner-thread KeyRelease request→XSync intervals for explicit client up can be nested in caller timing without changing admission or release semantics.
decisions.T: One disposable Xvfb fixture: single-key down/up, two-key down/down then sequential up/up with no intervening owner-state query, and cancellation after one admitted key before a second admission. Then independently audit.
decisions.D: PASS_OWNER_THREAD_KEYUP_BRACKET_SCOPED only if each predeclared release exists in exact order, key/owner/intent identities bind, explicit caller-owner timing nests, server-observed keymap transitions down→up, cancellation is classified without fabricated caller timestamps, authority/physical claims are false, and owner/thread/container cleanup is externally verified. Setup gap=STOP; semantic/control change=FAIL.
decisions.C: XSync is server-processing completion only; one Xvfb server and one fixture, no game/MAP01/model/provider/GPU/network/user desktop.
decisions.U: No application-consumption instant, MAP01 occupancy, efficacy, safety rate, latency, human tempo, reliability, or transfer claim.
